title: Report and dashboard name edits in the current language are not served when there is no packaged base or the override pair translates the slot
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up owed by PR #36420 (card #36373), L2 S2 (record 7079950960). Filed by the seat.

## What happens

The report and dashboard edit panels write a name in the current language as `{ default: SOURCE, LANG: EDIT }`. PR #36420 makes the server serve that entry over the packaged base's translation. Two cases stay open:

1. **No packaged base.** A report or dashboard that no code package ships (built in the deployment). The panel stores `{ default: SOURCE, LANG: EDIT }`, but the server still serves the translation bundle's entry for that language where one exists. After Save the box shows the bundle's translation again, and nothing tells the admin why.
2. **Override whose pair translates the slot.** On an installed package's item, once the paired `.custom` package ships a translation for that locale, the pair's translation answers ahead of the entry (ruling record 6631250894's order), so the same thing happens.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/servedLabel.ts` states both cases in its header.

## What should happen

The admin's edit is what readers in that language see, or the panel says why not. Two ways, pick one in the card:

- Save writes the translation row (the bundle or pair entry for that locale) instead of, or as well as, the inline map entry.
- The panel shows a note under the name box when a translation for this language will be served instead of the edit, naming where to change it.

## Done when

- In each of the two cases above, edit the name in zh-CN, Save, reload: the zh-CN reader sees the edit, or the panel showed the note before Save.
- Pinned on both the report page and the dashboard card panel.
